# Proset

> Proset is an AI voice notes recorder that turns spoken thoughts into polished tasks, emails, and summaries. Record a thought and get an actionable result — on web and Android.

## Important URLs

- [Proset home](https://proset.ai/): product overview, use-case examples, and pricing
- [Full product description](https://proset.ai/llms-full.txt): complete plain-text description, capabilities, pricing, and FAQ
- [Documentation](https://proset.ai/documentation/): full product documentation
- [Privacy policy](https://proset.ai/privacy): how Proset handles your data
- [Support](https://proset.ai/support/): contact and help
